build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places jars, balls, and bars in a physics scene
create_scene_objects: create dynamic jars, balls, and static bars using the C.add API in a PHYRE scene
define_task_goal: define a task goal by setting a TOUCHING spatial relationship between two balls
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to BALL using C.set_meta for task classification
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameters by raising SkipTemplateParams when constraints are violated
